Message from Sidra: sidra-hs, sidra-tn-vm and sidra-tn-ts are safe to stop. Nothing outside this Mac uses sidra-hs. They are my local stand-in for Webapp's tailnet, used only by two Simulator tests that skip when it's down. The real Webapp workspace runs on Webapp's own per-org Headscale on the lab node (preview.example.com), not on this Mac.
sidra-vm can also be stopped, but it has two effects. First, it is the build VM that the iPad app uses by default (devbox.example.ts.net:2222) until you connect a Webapp workspace in Settings, so the iPad shows the VM as unreachable until you do that. Second, most of the Simulator test suite needs it. Neither matters while Dev tests the Webapp path on the iPad. Start it again with `docker start sidra-vm` before running the Sidra tests.
